quarterly_data.quarter: Optowide Technologies annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-25-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: FY2025 results (annual report): revenue RMB 585,543,131.12, up 31.54% YoY; net profit attributable to shareholders RMB 70,616,360.85, up 1.80%; net profit excluding non-recurring items RMB 67,259,806.34, up 1.36%; net profit excluding share-based payment RMB 82,116,172.19, up 20.58% (2025 employee share plan expense RMB 844.76 ten-thousand); operating cash flow RMB 139,098,772.59, up 99.27%. Quarterly revenue: Q1 RMB 113,229,735.98, Q2 RMB 149,647,463.97, Q3 RMB 162,253,874.81, Q4 RMB 160,412,056.36; quarterly net profit: Q1 RMB 13,033,979.39, Q2 RMB 23,554,849.94, Q3 RMB 27,213,666.02, Q4 RMB 6,813,865.50. The company attributes revenue growth to AI-compute demand lifting volume of passive components for high-speed optical modules and large-size pure YVO4 crystals for OCS switches, a sharp rise in semiconductor-equipment optical module deliveries, and steady growth in high-damage-threshold fiber-laser components.

quarterly_data.quarter: Optowide Technologies annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-25-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Optical communications for AI (annual report): capacity of passive components for 800G/1.6T optical modules kept ramping; component orders for OCS switches achieved an important breakthrough; large-size pure YVO4 crystals (for OCS switches) reached mass production after the company solved the large-size crystal growth process, and the Hefei subsidiary's YVO4 crystal orders grew rapidly. The company says its CWDM filters for data-center high-speed modules and its optical components for WSS modules / OCS switches have high influence in their niches. A two-dimensional large-array collimator project to meet OCS makers' needs was at the design-development stage.

quarterly_data.quarter: Optowide Technologies annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-25-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Light engines and CPO (annual report): the company launched high-speed EML COB and silicon-photonics COB light engines with matching transceiver assemblies for pluggable high-speed modules, produced samples of several COB light engines, and brought high-precision optical-chip placement and coupling into production; CPO optical connectors for data centers and AI computing were in development and validation (R&D project at the trial-sample stage, aiming at mass production).

quarterly_data.signal: Capacity build-out (annual report, end-2025): fixed assets RMB 602,490,327.61, up 36.04% on equipment purchased for expansion; construction in progress RMB 107,251,160.90, up 894.41%, mainly a subsidiary's new plant not yet in production - the Optowide Technologies (Thailand) new plant has a budget of RMB 173,648,800.00 and the plant not yet completed at year-end. quarterly_data.quarter: Optowide Technologies annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-25-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: 2026 targets (annual report): assuming no major change in the macro environment, the company targets 2026 revenue and net profit attributable to the parent each up 50% or more versus 2025. Plans: expand capacity of key products to match market growth; push expansion and production start at the Thailand, Zhengzhou, Wuhan and Hefei plants; focus R&D on high-channel-count array collimators for optical communications and on high-end optical communications test equipment; build overseas sales in the US and Europe and raise the export share.
